source: upstream #17, #46, #73, #115, 9.1.0: GET /mockserver/config lists each unrecognised mockserver.*/MOCKSERVER_* key after the properties, value (ignored), with how it was set and the recognised keys in the same form it was most likely meant to be (normalised names, optimal string alignment distance, one edit per four characters, at most three); a system-property-only knob (candidateIndexThreshold, jsonSchemaAllowRemoteRefs) set in the file or the environment is reported with systemPropertyOnly; ?nonDefault=true leaves out the properties at their default and keeps the unrecognised entries. Overridden properties carry their built-in default. The five entries the oracle's Docker image fills from its own environment are masked out (at their default here, so not listed).

steps.note: the overridden properties with their defaults, then the unrecognised keys with their suggestions
the parameter's value is read ignoring case
